第43章 你他妈的给我立正说话！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

保卫处办公室内，刘济民的声音洪亮激昂，愤怒的表情中带着痛心：“黄处长，你究竟是如何混到阶级队伍里来的？”
刘济民气势汹涌，而我们的黄处长，此时气势不自觉地就弱了下来，脸上青一阵白一阵的。
不过为了压制住刘济民，黄东阳又猛地拍了拍桌子，厉喝道：“你不要扣帽子，我负责燕影厂的保卫工作，这是我的工作，你老实点！”
“现在已经不是发生冲突的问题了，我现在怀疑你的立场有问题！”刘济民开始巧妙地转换问题的关键点。
“我的立场有什么问题？我能有什么问题？你信不信我给你处分，让你电影拍不成！”
刘济民冷笑道：“你处分我？我是你们单位的吗？电影拍不成？赶紧停拍吧！按理说你这种级别的干部，还没有这方面的权力吧？燕影厂划拨经费二十万，停拍？这笔钱你来补？我的黄大处长，吹牛可以，别把牛给吹死了！”
拿停拍来威胁刘济民，还真是威胁错人了。威胁谢铁骊，都比威胁刘济民有用。
前前后后花了将近十万块，一旦停拍，刘济民拿着剧本稿费拍拍屁股走人了，燕影厂一地鸡毛，厂长汪阳和导演谢铁骊能把黄东阳给撕了当下酒菜。
黄东阳见拿刘济民没有办法，于是将门外的朱新运给喊了进来，要求他说一下情况。
门外面围满了剧组成员，朱霖满脸担忧，想进来解释，被黄东阳拒之门外。
“济民，精神点，别丢份儿！”杨波在门外大声喊道，“用不用我回去给你摇人儿去！”
朱新运进来之后，哆哆嗦嗦地看了一眼刘济民，黄东阳让他不要害怕，将自己知道的都说出来。
“你上次挨打的事情，也一并说出来！”黄东阳鼓励道。
在黄东阳的鼓励下，朱新运胆子大了起来，狂飙演技，哭诉道：“我那天都不知道怎么回事儿，我冤死了，正在宿舍打扫卫生，他冲进来‘啪啪’就是几巴掌，当时我以为我要死了，我都看见我太奶了....”
“继续说，不要怕，组织会给你做主的！”
朱新运继续添油加醋，望着刘济民，委屈地说道：“济民同志，我刚才是无意间看见的，咱们是有矛盾，但是我绝对不是故意的....”
“你他妈的给我立正说话，弯着腰一副奴才相像什么军人！”刘济民骂道。
“你他妈给我立正说话！”
门突然被人踹开，一声厉喝后，屋内屋外一片寂静，只有门板发出吱扭吱扭的声音。
刘济民转身一看，赶紧紧绷身体，笑着说道：“团长，您怎么来了？”

In the Security Office, Liu Jimin's voice was loud and passionate, and his angry expression was filled with pain: "Director Huang, how did you get into the class ranks?"
Liu Jimin's momentum was surging, but our Director Huang's momentum weakened unconsciously at this time, and his face turned blue and white.
However, in order to suppress Liu Jimin, Huang Dongyang slammed the table again and shouted: "Don't blame me, I am responsible for the security of Yan Film Factory. This is my job, please be honest!"
"It's no longer a matter of conflict. I now suspect that there is a problem with your position!" Liu Jimin began to cleverly change the key points of the issue.
"What's wrong with my position? What's wrong with me? Do you believe it or not? I'm going to punish you so that you can't make the movie!"
Liu Jimin sneered: "Are you going to punish me? Am I from your company? Can't the film be made? Stop the filming immediately! Logically speaking, a cadre of your level does not have the power in this regard, right? Yan Film Studio has allocated 200,000 yuan to stop filming? You will make up for the money? My Director Huang, you can brag, but don't brag to death!"
Threatening Liu Jimin with stopping filming was really a threat to the wrong person. Threatening Xie Tieli is more useful than threatening Liu Jimin.
It cost nearly 100,000 yuan. Once the filming was stopped, Liu Jimin took the script fee and walked away. Yan Film Studio was a mess. Director Wang Yang and director Xie Tieli were able to tear Huang Dongyang out of the banquet.
Huang Dongyang saw that there was nothing he could do against Liu Jimin, so he called Zhu Xinyun outside the door and asked him to tell him the situation.
The door was surrounded by crew members. Zhu Lin looked worried and wanted to come in to explain, but was turned away by Huang Dongyang.
"Jimin, be smart and don't lose your position!" Yang Bo shouted outside the door, "Do you need me to go back and shake you off?"
After Zhu Xinyun came in, he glanced at Liu Jimin tremblingly, and Huang Dongyang told him not to be afraid and to tell him everything he knew.
"Tell me what happened last time you were beaten!" Huang Dongyang encouraged.
Encouraged by Huang Dongyang, Zhu Xinyun became bolder and showed off his acting skills. He cried: "I don't know what happened that day. I was unjustly killed. I was cleaning the dormitory. He rushed in and slapped me a few times. At that time, I thought I was going to die. I saw that I was so milky..."
"Keep talking, don't be afraid, the organization will make the decision for you!"
Zhu Xinyun continued to add insult to injury, looked at Liu Jimin, and said aggrievedly: "Comrade Jimin, I just saw it accidentally. We have conflicts, but I definitely didn't mean it..."
"You stand up and speak to me, bending over like a slave, you look like a soldier!" Liu Jimin scolded.
"Stand to your fucking attention and speak!"
The door was suddenly kicked open, and after a sharp shout, there was silence inside and outside the house, only the door panel made a creaking sound.
Liu Jimin turned around to take a look, tensed up his body quickly, and said with a smile: "Captain, why are you here?"
